title: drosanthemum capillare
intro: Drosanthemum capillare, commonly known as the Cape Daisies, is a flowering plant species native to South Africa. The health benefits of Drosanthemum capillare include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its potential to reduce pain and inflammation, as well as its ability to act as an antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of Drosanthemum capillare include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
